facts.claim_text: Continue continuous cardiac monitoring with ST-segment surveillance for evolving myocardial injury.
facts.text: The patient is currently on continuous cardiac monitoring.
notes: concept set by the rule files: cardiac -> other
facts.label: supported
facts.reason: The records show ongoing cardiac monitoring up to the decision time: hourly heart rhythm measurements (most recently SR at 19:00, R50) and repeated 'ST Segment Monitoring On: 1' entries (most recently 16:00, R44), consistent with the patient currently being on continuous cardiac monitoring.

facts.claim_text: Continue aspirin 162 mg PO/NG for antiplatelet therapy.
